insight: Born in Y Combinator's W20 batch; the company says 98% of its customers use it entirely for free.
name: PostHog
tagline: Open-source product analytics with LLM observability built in.
description: A product analytics platform that folds session replay, feature flags, experiments, and a data warehouse into one stack. Its LLM analytics suite tracks traces, token costs, latency, and model errors for AI products, with automatic clustering that groups traces by behavior. Usage-based pricing with a generous free tier on every product.

modelSupport.notes: LLM analytics captures traces and costs across providers via SDKs and integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, LiteLLM, …).

edge: Folds LLM analytics into the same platform as product analytics, replay and flags — one stack instead of a separate AI-observability tool.
pros: LLM analytics + replay + flags in one
cons: Product breadth can overwhelm small teams
Self-hosting supported at hobby scale only
Lighter agent tracing than dedicated LLM-obs tools
